description: This file defines utility functions for creating lazily loaded runtime modules, surfaces, exports, and methods in a TypeScript project. It provides mechanisms to cache dynamically imported modules and select specific parts of them in a deferred manner.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeSurface<TModule, TSurface>( createLazyRuntimeSurface
methods.description: Creates a lazy surface for a runtime module, caching the result after first import and selection.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeModule<TModule>( createLazyRuntimeModule
methods.description: Creates a lazy loader for the entire runtime module, caching the import.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeNamedExport<TModule, const TKey extends keyof TModule>( createLazyRuntimeNamedExport
methods.description: Creates a lazy loader for a named export of the runtime module.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethod<TSurface, TArgs extends unknown[], TResult>( createLazyRuntimeMethod
methods.description: Creates a lazy-invoked method from a surface, loading and selecting the method when invoked.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder<TSurface>(load: () => Promise<TSurface>) { createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder
methods.description: Returns a binder function that creates lazy methods from a loaded surface.
